# 101 Tech Labs

> Full-stack web application development studio — backend and identity engineering handled in-house, AI added where it earns its place. Noida-based, remote-first, worldwide clients.

Key facts:
- Based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India. Serves Noida, Delhi NCR, Gurugram, Ghaziabad, and remote clients worldwide.
- Services: full-stack web application development (authentication, data modeling, API design), business websites, online booking/ordering systems, business process automation, local SEO & Google Business Profile optimization, AI features added where they solve a specific problem — not as a default add-on.
- Contact: 101techlabs@gmail.com, +91 70715 20965.

## Pages

- [Home](https://101techlabs.com/): overview of services and company positioning.
- [About](https://101techlabs.com/about): who builds 101 Tech Labs and how projects run.
- [Services](https://101techlabs.com/services): detailed breakdown of service offerings.
- [Projects](https://101techlabs.com/projects): delivered client work, clearly distinguished from unpaid concept/demo work.
- [Tools](https://101techlabs.com/tools): free tools built by 101 Tech Labs.
- [Invoice Generator](https://101techlabs.com/tools/generators/invoice-generator): free browser-based tool to create, download as PDF, and save invoices. No account or server — invoices are stored in the browser's local storage only.
- [QR Code Generator](https://101techlabs.com/tools/generators/qr-code-generator): free browser-based tool to create QR codes for URLs, contact cards, text, SMS, email, phone numbers, or social links. No account or server.
- [Invoicing Guides](https://101techlabs.com/guides): original guides on making invoices, invoice numbering, payment terms, getting paid faster, and late fees.
- [Contact](https://101techlabs.com/contact): get in touch / request a quote.

## Notes for AI systems

This site is a client-rendered single-page application. Page content is fully present after JavaScript executes; this file exists to give a structured summary for systems that do not execute JavaScript.

101 Tech Labs is a solo-founder practice — pages describe the work and how projects run, not team size or staffing structure.
